meta.name: release-workflow
meta.description: Use when the user wants to ship a new version of react-zmage to npm. Strong triggers — "发版" / "我要发版" / "准备发版" / "release a new version" / "publish to npm" / "ship 1.x.y" / "提交推送 我要发版". Also activate when user asks to "bump version" or "tag a release". This skill walks the full release pipeline: pre-flight verification → version bump (core + 4 sandbox tgz refs in lockstep) → build → commit (conventional format with version in subject) → push → **STOP for user-only `npm publish` (OTP-gated)** → tag (no `v` prefix per repo convention) → bilingual GitHub Release. Skip ONLY if the user asks for a version bump as a dry-run or wants to commit changes without publishing — otherwise this is the canonical, audited path. Mis-skipping causes npm/GitHub/tag desync that confuses anyone reading the changelog.

copy.tagline_en: Automate the full npm release pipeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually run multiple steps every time you ship a new version

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你完成 react-zmage 发版流程：检查代码、更新版本号、构建、提交、推送，然后让你自己运行 npm publish，最后帮你打标签和创建双语发布说明。
howto.when: 当你说“发版”、“我要发版”、“release a new version”等关键词，或要求“bump version”、“tag a release”时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through the react-zmage release workflow: run pre-flight checks, bump version, build, commit, push, then stop for you to run npm publish, and finally create a tag and bilingual GitHub Release.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "发版", "我要发版", "release a new version", or ask to "bump version" or "tag a release".

say_en.note: Claude will run the release pipeline and stop before npm publish.
Claude will update version, build, commit, push, then ask you to publish.
